answer_4.quote: We enlist a domain expert (radiologist) to conduct annotations to complement our retrospective quantitative evaluations. We elicit judgements on a fivepoint Likert scale regarding the recall, precision, and "intuitiveness" of image highlights induced for text snippets.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate heatmaps on a five‑point Likert scale for recall, precision, and intuitiveness.
